prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A flat 2D cartoon sticker-style illustration of a chubby chibi baby giraffe losing its mind with laughter. Character design: an oversized round head sitting on a short thick neck, a small pear-shaped body, stubby little legs with dark hooves, tiny short arms, a skinny tail with a tuft at the tip, two short knob-tipped horns on top of the head, wide leaf-shaped ears sticking out sideways, and a broad rounded muzzle with two small nostril dots. Bright butter-yellow fur patterned with soft rounded orange-brown giraffe patches, pale cream belly and muzzle, small brown horn knobs. Thick uniform black outlines, flat solid color fills, minimal cel shading, no gradients, cute cheap mascot-cartoon look.

Expression is the whole point: the head is thrown back and tilted slightly, eyes squeezed completely shut into two thick black upward-curving arcs (^ ^), tiny eyebrows popped high above them, cheeks pushed up into round bumps, and a GIGANTIC wide-open laughing mouth that spans almost the entire face and is absurdly too large for the head — a huge dark maroon cavern shaped like a wide sideways "D", one row of big flat white blocky teeth along the upper edge, and a fat glossy pink tongue flopping in the lower half. Two fat cartoon teardrops squirt out sideways from the corners of the shut eyes. Both front hooves are pressed against its round belly, body doubled over, one hind hoof kicked up behind it, small black shake marks and motion lines around the head and shoulders. The feeling is hysterical, unhinged, can't-breathe, slightly mocking laughter — not gentle or polite.

Plain flat white background, full body centered, square composition, bright even lighting, bold saturated colors, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no realistic fur texture.
